title: Asymptotic Analysis Q9 - Halving Loop with Halving Helper
general_notes: No double deduction (except in points 9 and 10).
Students can use Theta or big-O notation with tight bounds.
Intended answers: T_f(N) = Theta((log N)^2) and T_g(N) = Theta(log N) in the worst case (when m = N).
Both Theta(log N) x Theta(log N) = Theta((log N)^2) and an explicit sum of the per-iteration log costs are acceptable for f's total.

rubric_points.name: Splitting code into parts + referencing line numbers
rubric_points.target: Clear separation of f and g; loop vs non-loop code identified; line numbers referenced consistently.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Analysis does not clearly separate f vs g, or loops vs non-loops, and line numbers are unclear or missing.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Some attempt to separate components or refer to line numbers, but structure is incomplete or ambiguous.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Clear separation of f and g and identification of the call to g inside f's loop; line numbers referenced consistently.

rubric_points.name: Constant-time non-loop parts
rubric_points.target: All non-loop code in f and g is Theta(1).

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Non-loop code not analysed or incorrectly claimed to be non-constant.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Some constant-time segments identified but others missing.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: All non-loop regions stated as Theta(1).

rubric_points.name: f(): Loop iterations
rubric_points.target: Theta(log N) iterations because k is halved each iteration.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Iteration count missing or not Theta(log N) (e.g. claims Theta(N)).

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: States Theta(log N) but does not explain the halving of k.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Justifies Theta(log N) because k starts at N and is divided by 2 each iteration until it reaches 0.

rubric_points.name: f(): Cost per iteration
rubric_points.target: Theta(log N) per iteration in the worst case, dominated by the call to g(a, k).

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Claims Theta(1) per iteration or ignores the cost of g.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Recognises the call to g but does not establish Theta(log N) per iteration.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: States Theta(log N) per iteration in the worst case (first iteration m = N), justified by g being a halving loop; the halving and += are Theta(1).

rubric_points.name: f(): Total loop cost
rubric_points.target: Theta((log N)^2) from Theta(log N) iterations x Theta(log N) per iteration.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: No combination of iteration count and per-iteration cost, or unrelated complexity (e.g. claims Theta(log N) or Theta(N)).

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Multiplies own values but final simplification or reasoning is unclear or incorrect.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Theta(log N) x Theta(log N) = Theta((log N)^2), with justification.

rubric_points.name: g(): Loop iterations
rubric_points.target: Theta(log N) iterations in the worst case because j is halved each iteration (j starts at m, worst case m = N).

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Iteration count missing or not Theta(log N).

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: States Theta(log N) but does not explain the halving of j or the worst case m = N.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Justifies Theta(log m) iterations (worst case m = N gives Theta(log N)) because j starts at m and is divided by 2 each iteration.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Claims non-constant per-iteration cost, or does not clearly state cost per iteration.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Suggests constant time but lacks explicit Theta(1) justification.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Each iteration Theta(1): one array read, one += assignment, one division, one comparison.

rubric_points.name: g(): Total loop cost
rubric_points.target: Theta(log N) = Theta(log N) iterations x Theta(1) per iteration (worst case m = N).

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Does not combine iteration count x per-iteration cost.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: Attempts multiplication using own values but unclear or partially derived.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Theta(log N) x Theta(1) = Theta(log N), with justification.

rubric_points.name: Overall worst-case runtime of g
rubric_points.target: T_g(N) = Theta(log N) in the worst case (m = N), summing the constant parts and the loop.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Runtime absent or incompatible with earlier analysis.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: States Theta(log N) but with missing reasoning.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Theta(1) + Theta(log N) + Theta(1) = Theta(log N).

rubric_points.name: Overall worst-case runtime of f
rubric_points.target: T_f(N) = Theta((log N)^2), accounting for non-loop parts + loop.

buckets.label: Wrong
buckets.description: Final complexity missing/incorrect and not derived from loop analysis.

buckets.label: Semi
buckets.description: States Theta((log N)^2) but with missing reasoning.

buckets.label: Correct
buckets.description: Theta(1) + Theta((log N)^2) + Theta(1) = Theta((log N)^2).
